summary: tooling_image_test.sh against private copies of vendor/gnu/tooling_image.sh with faults in its stop

faults.name: second-signal
faults.summary: a later signal not ignored once the script stops, which must fail exactly the row whose second SIGTERM comes while the script waits for the job

faults.name: not-passed-on
faults.summary: no SIGTERM given to etude-tooling, which must fail exactly the rows of a signal that reaches the script alone and of SIGINT, which a job started in the background ignores unless it sets a handler

faults.name: lock-released-early
faults.summary: the stage and the lock removed without waiting for etude-tooling to end, which must fail the rows of a signal to a job that keeps the lock until it has stopped

faults.name: no-sweep
faults.summary: the stages of jobs killed outright left in place, which must fail exactly the row of SIGKILL and the run after it
